description: No defined processes for physically restricting access to the CDE.
applicability: This signal applies to: Data centers and server rooms housing CDE Point-of-sale (POS) environments Payment terminal locations SIEM and log management systems All systems within CDE scope

related_controls: 9.1 Processes and mechanisms for restricting physical access to cardholder data are defined and understood
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of documented physical security policies, lack of defined processes for CDE access control, missing physical security procedures, or absence of physical access restriction mechanisms in policy documentation.
